title: The shock barely reached the shelf

metadata.comparison: India's realised crude import price was 81% above its February level at the May peak. Retail petrol inflation in July was 7.5%.
metadata.caveat: MOSPI rebased the CPI to 2024 from January 2026; these are not continuous with the 2012-base series, which ends in December 2025. Year-on-year is computable only from December 2025. These are inflation rates, not a pass-through estimate, which would need pump prices and tax rates.
